words.ex: The children played on the rubble after the building fell.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物倒塌后，孩子们在碎石上玩耍。
words.en: Rubble is the broken pieces of stone, brick, etc., that are left when a building falls down or is destroyed.

words.tr: n. 嗅探器，以鼻吸毒者
words.ex: The network administrator used a sniffer to detect any unusual traffic.
words.ex_cn: 网络管理员使用嗅探器来检测任何异常流量。
words.en: A sniffer is a device or program that intercepts and logs traffic passing over a digital network or part of a network. As data streams flow across the network, the sniffer captures each packet and, if needed, decodes the packet's raw data, showing the values of various fields in the packet, and analyzes its content according to the appropriate RFC or other specifications.

words.tr: v. （与…）交往，联谊（ socialize的过去式和过去分词 ）; 使适合于过社会生活 adj.
words.ex: He socialized with his classmates after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后，他和同学们交往。
words.en: If something is socialized, it is made suitable for living in a community or society.

words.ex: The bright light was a stimulus for the baby to open his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的光线是让婴儿睁开眼睛的刺激物。
words.en: Something that causes growth or activity.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: He unscrewed the bottle cap slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢拧开了瓶盖。
words.en: If you unscrew something, you loosen it by turning it.

words.tr: abbr. 盒式磁带录像机；“Video Cassette Recorder”的缩写
words.ex: We watched the movie on the VCR last night.
words.ex_cn: n. 昨晚我们用录像机看了那部电影。
words.en: A VCR is a machine that uses videotapes to record and play television programs.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr:
n. 录像带；
v. 给…录像；
words.ex: He found an old videotape in the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他在抽屉里找到了一盘旧录像带。
words.en: Videotape is magnetic tape used for recording video images, typically along with sound.

words.ex: She used a washcloth to clean her face.
words.ex_cn: 她用毛巾擦脸。
words.en: A washcloth is a small cloth used for washing oneself, especially the face and hands.

words.ex: He went to the washroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A room with facilities for washing and usually also toilet facilities; a bathroom.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

chapters.name: Unit 6 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: v. 以…为基础；“base”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 基地 (或总部) 在…的；办公地点在…的（不用于名词前）；
words.ex: The movie is based on a true story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个真实故事为基础。
words.en: If one thing is based on another, the first thing is developed from or uses the second thing as its main idea or starting point.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 领导；负责；带领（团队、项目等）；使头部向上
words.ex: She will head up the new project.
words.ex_cn: 她将领导这个新项目。
words.en: To lead or be in charge of something; to move in a particular direction.

words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: phrase. 伸出援手；帮忙；助一臂之力
words.ex: Can you lend me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: To offer assistance or help to someone.

words.ex: Can you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: To help someone with something.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出援手；提供帮助
words.ex: He offers a hand to help his friend stand up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出援手帮助朋友站起来。
words.en: To offer a hand means to offer help or assistance to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出援手；给予帮助；助一臂之力
words.ex: He lent her a helping hand when she was struggling with homework.
words.ex_cn: 当她做作业遇到困难时，他帮了她一把。
words.en: To provide practical help or support to someone in need.

words.tr: 短语动词. 给……以帮助；助……一臂之力
words.ex: He gave her a helping hand with the heavy bag.
words.ex_cn: 他帮她提了沉重的袋子。
words.en: To provide assistance or support to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出援手；主动提供帮助
words.ex: Whenever someone is in need, she is always ready to offer ... a helping hand.
words.ex_cn: 每当有人需要帮助时，她总是愿意伸出援手。
words.en: To offer assistance or support to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 在工作中的；上班时的；在岗位上的；在职的
words.ex: She learned a lot on the job.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作中学到了很多。
words.en: While someone is working or during the course of employment.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 嗅出；察觉出；发现（尤指隐藏的事物）
words.ex: Dogs can sniff out drugs at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 狗能在机场嗅出毒品。
words.en: To detect or discover something by or as if by smelling.

words.tr: phrase. 说到，谈及（用于引出新话题）
words.ex: Speaking of the project, have you finished the report?
words.ex_cn: 说到那个项目，你报告写完了吗？
words.en: Used to introduce a topic that is related to what has just been mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.ex: He tried to track down his old friend from school.
words.ex_cn: 他试图找到他以前的学校朋友。
words.en: To find someone or something after searching for them.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: n. 咨询服务； v. “counsel”的现在分词；
words.ex: He went to school counseling for help with stress.
words.ex_cn: 他去学校咨询服务中心寻求减压帮助。
words.en: Counseling is the process of helping someone to deal with and understand their problems by listening to them and giving them advice.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: The teacher asked a simple question to elicit answers from students.
words.ex_cn: 老师问了一个简单的问题来引出学生的回答。
words.en: To elicit a response or a reaction means to cause it to happen by something that you say or do.

words.ex: The emptiness of the desert made him feel alone.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的空旷让他感到孤独。
words.en: the state of containing nothing

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: Her impulsiveness often led to regrettable decisions.
words.ex_cn: 她的冲动常常导致令人后悔的决定。
words.en: The quality of being impulsive, acting without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.ex: She ordinarily wakes up at six o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 她通常六点起床。
words.en: In a usual or normal manner.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: He publicly apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他公开为自己的错误道歉。
words.en: In a way that is open or visible to the public; not privately.

words.tr:
v. 重新进入
n. 重进入
words.ex: After a brief break, she reentered the room.
words.ex_cn: 短暂的休息后，她再次进入了房间。
words.en: To enter again.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: He enjoys solitude in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在森林中独处。
words.en: The state or situation of being alone.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 有改革能力的；变化的
words.ex: The new teacher made a transformative change in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师给班级带来了变革性的改变。
words.en: having the power to transform or cause a significant change in something

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr: adj. 独立的；未订婚的；未被查封的；未任命的
words.ex: She lived an unattached life, focusing on her career.
words.ex_cn: 她过着独立的生活，专注于自己的事业。
words.en: If someone is unattached, they are not married or not involved in a romantic relationship.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.ex: The old factory became a wasteland after it closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，它变成了一片荒地。
words.en: A wasteland is an area of land that is uncultivated or uninhabited, often because it is barren or devastated.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: phrase. 让步；退缩；放弃原先的立场或要求
words.ex: He won't back down even when he's wrong.
words.ex_cn: 即使他错了，他也不会退让。
words.en: To withdraw from a commitment or position, often in the face of opposition or after a confrontation.

words.tr: phrase. v. 试验；尝试；对……进行实验
words.ex: Scientists often experiment with new materials to find the best one for their needs.
words.ex_cn: 科学家经常试验新材料，以找到最适合他们需求的那种。
words.en: To try out new ideas or methods in order to see what results they produce.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逃离；摆脱；离开
words.ex: He wants to get away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想逃离喧闹的城市。
words.en: To escape from a place or a situation.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 全心全意地；衷心地
words.ex: He loves music with all his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他全心全意地热爱音乐。
words.en: With all one's heart means to do something with complete sincerity, enthusiasm, and commitment.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: The camel walks slowly across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼缓慢地走过沙漠。
words.en: A camel is a large animal that lives in the desert and has one or two humps on its back.

words.ex: The carmaker released a new electric model.
words.ex_cn: 这家汽车制造商发布了一款新的电动车。
words.en: A carmaker is a company that manufactures cars.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The detective solved the mystery with clues.
words.ex_cn: 侦探用线索破解了谜案。
words.en: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr: n. 射击；射程；炮击; adj. 射击的；枪炮射击所致的
words.ex: The gunshot echoed through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 枪声在山谷中回荡。
words.en: The sound made when a gun is fired.

words.ex: He felt nostalgia when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，感到怀旧。
words.en: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.tr: n. 漫游者；流浪者；漂泊者；
words.ex: The rover explored the surface of Mars.
words.ex_cn: 漫游者探索了火星表面。
words.en: A rover is someone who travels around, often without a fixed route or destination. It can also refer to a vehicle designed to travel over the rough surface of a planet or moon.

words.ex: The royalty lived in a large palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇族住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royalty refers to people of royal blood or status, or a sum of money paid to an author, composer, etc., for each copy of a work sold or for each public performance of their work.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: The soldier was spying on the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在夜间秘密侦察敌军营地。
words.en: A spy is a person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.tr: adj. 横跨西伯利亚的；n. 横跨西伯利亚的铁路
words.ex: The Trans-Siberian Railway is one of the longest railway lines in the world.
words.ex_cn: 横跨西伯利亚的铁路是世界上最长的铁路线之一。
words.en: Trans-Siberian refers to something that crosses or extends across Siberia, especially the Trans-Siberian Railway, which connects Moscow with the Russian Far East and the Sea of Japan.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He drank a glass of vodka last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚喝了一杯伏特加。
words.en: A clear, strong alcoholic drink made from grain or potatoes, originally from Russia.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The heat can bring on a headache.
words.ex_cn: 炎热会引发头痛。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to lead to a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 修理；安排； 为（某人）提供
words.ex: He will fix up his bike tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要修理他的自行车。
words.en: To repair, arrange, or organize something.

words.tr: phrase. 停业；倒闭；停止营业
words.ex: The small shop went out of business last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家小店去年倒闭了。
words.en: If a company or business goes out of business, it stops operating, especially because it has failed.

words.ex: The train arrived on schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on schedule, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 在移动中；在行进；在忙碌活动；不断前进
words.ex: The children are on the move, playing outside.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在移动中，在外面玩耍。
words.en: If you are on the move, you are going from one place to another, often in a hurry or because you are busy.

words.ex: I eat ice cream once in a while.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔吃冰淇淋。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: The bus will pull into the station in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车将在五分钟后进站。
words.en: To arrive at a particular place, especially a station or harbor, by moving towards it.

words.tr: n. 国家或组织的法定歌曲
words.ex: The team sang the national anthem before the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛前，球队唱了国歌。
words.en: An anthem is a song that is used to represent a particular nation, society, or group and that is sung on special occasions.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.ex: He went to the casino to play poker.
words.ex_cn: 他去赌场玩扑克。
words.en: A casino is a building where people can gamble by playing games of chance or betting on events.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colorful picture of the rainbow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的彩虹画。
words.en: Something that is colorful has bright colors or a lot of different colors.

words.ex: The fish swim among the coral in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海中的珊瑚间游动。
words.en: A hard stony substance secreted by certain marine coelenterates as an external skeleton, typically forming large reefs in warm seas.

words.ex: Their cordiality made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友善让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Cordiality is behavior that is friendly and sincere.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.ex: The diver swam deep under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在海底深处游泳。
words.en: A diver is someone who swims under water, especially someone who works under water looking for things or repairing ships.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.ex: The children played on the big dune near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海边的大沙丘上玩耍。
words.en: A dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a desert, formed by the wind.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: The town was alive with festivity during the carnival.
words.ex_cn: 狂欢节期间，小镇充满了喜庆的气氛。
words.en: Festivity refers to the celebration of something in a joyful and exuberant manner.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: The freighter was loaded with tons of cargo.
words.ex_cn: 这艘货船装载了数吨货物。
words.en: A freighter is a large ship or aircraft designed to carry goods.

words.ex: His greatness inspired many people.
words.ex_cn: 他的伟大激励了很多人。
words.en: Greatness is the quality of being great, distinguished, or eminent in some positive capacity.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: He rode the horse on horseback.
words.ex_cn: 他骑在马背上。
words.en: If you do something on horseback, you do it while riding a horse.

words.ex: The host showed great hospitality to the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主人对客人表现出极大的款待。
words.en: Hospitality is friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, especially by giving them food, drink, or a place to stay.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is marvelous.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色极好。
words.en: If you describe something as marvelous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.ex: The settler built a house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位定居者在河边建了一所房子。
words.en: A settler is a person who moves to a new place with the intention of staying there, especially in a previously uninhabited or sparsely inhabited area.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: The old shipwreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的残骸躺在海底。
words.en: A shipwreck is the destruction of a ship at sea by sinking or breaking up, for example in a storm or after hitting a rock.

words.ex: They spent the afternoon playing shuffleboard on the deck.
words.ex_cn: 他们下午在甲板上玩推圆盘游戏。
words.en: Shuffleboard is a game in which players use cues to push weighted discs, sending them gliding down a narrow court, with the aim of having them come to rest within a marked scoring area.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: The sunbather lay on the beach, enjoying the warm sun.
words.ex_cn: 晒太阳的人躺在沙滩上，享受着温暖的阳光。
words.en: A sunbather is a person who lies or sits in the sun, especially in order to get a suntan.

words.tr: n. 游泳运动员；游泳者；
words.ex: He is a fast swimmer who won the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名速度快的游泳运动员，赢得了金牌。
words.en: A swimmer is a person who swims, especially as a sport or regularly for exercise.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.tr: adj. 难以相信的；难以置信的；
words.ex: The magic trick was unbelievable.
words.ex_cn: 那个魔术难以相信。
words.en: If you say that something is unbelievable, you are emphasizing that it is very good, impressive, intense, or extreme.

words.ex: The beach is uncrowded on weekdays.
words.ex_cn: 工作日时，海滩人很少。
words.en: An uncrowded place does not have many people in it and is therefore pleasant and peaceful.

words.ex: The undersea cable connects two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条海底电缆连接了两个国家。
words.en: Located, occurring, or used beneath the surface of the sea.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: The warmth of the sun made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的温暖让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality, state, or sensation of being warm; moderate and comfortable heat.

words.tr: phrase. 水上滑板；水上滑雪
words.ex: He loves water skiing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末玩水上滑板。
words.en: Water skiing is a surface water sport in which an individual is pulled behind a boat or a cable ski installation over a body of water, skimming the surface on two skis or one ski.

words.ex: The windsurfer expertly navigated the choppy waters.
words.ex_cn: 这位帆板运动员熟练地驾驭着波涛汹涌的水面。
words.en: A windsurfer is a person who rides a windsurf board, which is a board with a sail attached, over water.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 源自；从…传下来；是…的后裔
words.ex: He claims to be descended from royalty.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己是皇室后裔。
words.en: To have someone as an ancestor; to originate from something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；踏足（某地），常用于否定句或条件句中，如 'set foot in'
words.ex: He set foot in the city for the first time in ten years.
words.ex_cn: 他十年后第一次踏足这座城市。
words.en: If you set foot somewhere, you go there or enter there.

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；优美的；得体的；
words.ex: The dancer moved in a graceful way.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者动作优雅。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as graceful, you mean that they move in a smooth, controlled, and attractive way.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.ex: The investigator asked the witness a few simple questions.
words.ex_cn: 调查员问了证人几个简单的问题。
words.en: An investigator is someone whose job is to investigate a crime, accident, or other matter.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: He is largely responsible for the project's success.
words.ex_cn: 他主要对这个项目的成功负责。
words.en: To a great extent; mostly.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: The painting has a strong likeness to the real person.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与真人非常相似。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar to something or someone else.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.ex: The change in her mood was observable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化是能察觉到的。
words.en: Something that is observable can be seen or noticed.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr: n. 预定，预言; 天数; 天缘
words.ex: The concept of predestination is central to many religions.
words.ex_cn: 预定论是许多宗教的核心概念。
words.en: The belief that everything that happens has already been decided by God or fate and cannot be changed.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: The children cleaned their rooms separately.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们分别打扫了自己的房间。
words.en: If people or things are dealt with separately, they are dealt with individually, not in a group.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: He lives in the southeastern part of the country.
words.ex_cn: 他住在国家的东南部。
words.en: located in or towards the southeast

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.tr: adj. 不分离的，未分隔的，分不开的
words.ex: The couple had an unseparated bond that lasted a lifetime.
words.ex_cn: 这对夫妇有不分离的纽带，持续了一生。
words.en: Not divided or split into parts.

words.ex: The table is unstable and might fall.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子不稳，可能会倒。
words.en: Something that is unstable is not firm and therefore not safe, or is likely to change suddenly and become worse.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 有可能做某事；易于发生某事
words.ex: If you don't follow the instructions, you are liable to make mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不按照指示去做，你可能会犯错误。
words.en: If someone is liable to do something, they are likely to do it or have a tendency to do it, often because of a characteristic or situation.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.tr: adv. 准确地；精确地；正确地；
words.ex: He measured the length accurately.
words.ex_cn: 他准确地测量了长度。
words.en: In a way that is correct or exact.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.ex: It's a coincidence that we both wore blue today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天都穿了蓝色，真是巧合。
words.en: A coincidence is when two or more similar or related events occur at the same time by chance and without any planning.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: He bit his fingernail when he was nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他紧张时会咬指甲。
words.en: Your fingernails are the thin hard areas at the end of each of your fingers.

words.tr:
n. 指纹；指印
v. 采指纹
words.ex: The police found his fingerprint on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 警察在玻璃上找到了他的指纹。
words.en: A fingerprint is a mark made by the pattern of ridges on the pad of a human finger, used for identification purposes.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: The twin boys are fraternal twins.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩是异卵双胞胎。
words.en: Fraternal is used to describe feelings or actions that are like those of a brother towards his brothers or sisters.

words.ex: Early detection of glaucoma is crucial for preventing vision loss.
words.ex_cn: 青光眼的早期检测对于预防视力丧失至关重要。
words.en: A disease of the eye in which the pressure of fluid inside the eyeball is abnormally high, damaging the optic disc and impairing vision, sometimes progressing to blindness.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.tr:
adj. 不信奉国教的；不墨守成规的；不随大流的
n. 不墨守成规者；（不信奉英国国教的）新教徒
words.ex: He is a nonconformist who does not attend church.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名不信奉国教的人，不去教堂。
words.en: A nonconformist is someone who does not conform to prevailing ideas or practices in their behavior or views.

words.ex: He likes all fruits, notably apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use notably to specify an important or typical example of something that you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 教养；养育；培育；
v. 培养；
words.ex: Her parents gave her good nurture.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母给了她良好的教养。
words.en: To nurture someone or something is to care for and encourage their growth or development.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.ex: The explorer found an undiscovered island.
words.ex_cn: 探险家发现了一个未被发现的岛屿。
words.en: If something is undiscovered, it has not been discovered or found out.

words.tr: adj. 未报告的，没有报道的，未经报道的
words.ex: The accident remained unreported for several days.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故好几天都没有被报道。
words.en: If something is unreported, it has not been reported, especially in newspapers or on television or radio.

words.ex: He enjoys woodworking as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把木工当作一种爱好。
words.en: Woodworking is the activity or skill of making things from wood.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 大量的，堆积如山的（用于形容数量极多的事物）
words.ex: She has a mountain of work to do before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 她在截止日期前有很多工作要做。
words.en: A very large amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 必定会做某事；注定要做某事
words.ex: With his talent, he is bound to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 凭借他的才能，他注定会成功。
words.en: If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: The teacher designated him as the group leader.
words.ex_cn: 老师指派他为组长。
words.en: If you designate someone or something as a particular thing, you formally give them that description or name.

words.tr: adv. 令人不安地，动摇地
words.ex: The news was disturbingly accurate.
words.ex_cn: 这消息准确得令人不安。
words.en: In a manner that causes anxiety or concern; unsettlingly.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: The report gives an exhaustive list of all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告给出了所有规则的详尽列表。
words.en: If you describe a study, search, or list as exhaustive, you mean that it is very thorough and complete.

words.ex: She has traveled extensively across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 她广泛地游历了欧洲。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.ex: The results changed markedly after the new method was used.
words.ex_cn: 使用新方法后，结果显著地改变了。
words.en: In a way that is clearly noticeable or significant.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.tr: adj. 最低限度的；极少的；最小的；
words.ex: He made minimal changes to the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对计划做了最低限度的修改。
words.en: Something that is minimal is very small in quantity, value, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.tr: adj. 精神病的；精神病学的；
words.ex: He works in a psychiatric hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家精神病医院工作。
words.en: Psychiatric means relating to psychiatry or to mental illness.

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

words.tr: v. 维持生活；生存下去
words.ex: They subsist on rice and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他们靠米饭和蔬菜维持生活。
words.en: If people subsist, they are just able to obtain the food or money that they need in order to stay alive.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 把……奉献给……；致力于……（通常用于表达将时间、精力、资源等投入到某事或某人）
words.ex: He devotes two hours to reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天花两个小时读书。
words.en: To give all or a large part of your time or resources to a person, activity, or cause.

words.tr: phrase. 使…不进入…；把…排除在…之外；避免…卷入…
words.ex: Close the door to keep the cold out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 关上门，让寒冷远离房间。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a particular place or being involved in a particular situation.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.tr: n. 加速器；油门；促进剂
words.ex: He pressed the accelerator to speed up the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下油门让车加速。
words.en: An accelerator is a device in a vehicle that you press with your foot to make the vehicle go faster.

words.ex: He works in the aerospace industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在航空航天行业工作。
words.en: The branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and space flight.

words.tr: phrase. α波；阿尔法脑波（一种脑电波，通常出现在放松、清醒但闭眼的状态下）
words.ex: The alpha wave is a type of brain wave associated with a relaxed state.
words.ex_cn: α波是一种与放松状态相关的脑电波。
words.en: An alpha wave is a type of brain wave that occurs in the frequency range of 8-12 Hz and is associated with a state of relaxation and wakeful rest.

words.ex: The ambient temperature was very cool.
words.ex_cn: 周围的温度非常凉爽。
words.en: Ambient is used to describe something that is present in the surrounding area or environment.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.ex: He sang a old ballad about love and war.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一首关于爱情与战争的老民谣。
words.en: A ballad is a type of song that tells a story, often a folk song or a slow romantic song.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.tr:
adj. 交战的；寻衅的；好战的
n. 交战国；交战团体
words.ex: The two belligerent nations signed a peace treaty.
words.ex_cn: 这两个交战国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: A belligerent person or country is aggressive and eager to fight.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The mother fed her baby with her breast.
words.ex_cn: 母亲用乳房喂养她的婴儿。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or the similar part on a bird or animal.

words.tr: n. 车用电话；汽车无线电话
words.ex: He used the carphone to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他用车载电话呼救。
words.en: A carphone is a mobile phone that is designed for use in a car, often with a hands-free system.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The city was covered in haze this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上这座城市被雾霾笼罩。
words.en: Haze is a light mist or fog, especially one caused by the heat of the sun or by pollution.

words.tr:
n. 高科技
adj. 高技术的
words.ex: He works in a high-tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高科技公司工作。
words.en: Involving or using advanced technology.

words.tr: adj. 恐怖的；令人震惊的
words.ex: The accident was horrific.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故非常可怕。
words.en: If you say that something is horrific, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant and shocking.

words.ex: His inattention caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: Lack of attention; negligence.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.ex: The poison is lethal to humans.
words.ex_cn: 这种毒药对人类是致命的。
words.en: Something that is lethal can kill people or animals.

words.ex: There was a lull in the rain before the storm came back.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨再次来临前，雨下了一阵间歇。
words.en: A lull is a short period of quiet or calm in an otherwise noisy or hectic situation. To lull means to cause someone to feel calm or to fall asleep.

words.tr: n. 标记；斑纹；打分； v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；“mark”的现在分词；
words.ex: The marking on the map shows the route.
words.ex_cn: 地图上的标记显示了路线。
words.en: A marking is a pattern or area of color on an animal's body, or a sign or symbol that is used to indicate something.

words.ex: He drives on the motorway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在高速公路上开车。
words.en: A motorway is a wide road specially built for fast travel over long distances, with a limited number of places at which drivers can enter and leave it.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr: v. 显露；泄露；透露；“reveal”的现在分词； adj. 有启示作用的；
words.ex: The mirror revealed his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 镜子显露了他真实的情感。
words.en: Providing interesting or significant information that was not previously known or realized.

words.ex: The engine revs up when you press the accelerator.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩下油门时，发动机会加速。
words.en: To increase the speed of an engine rapidly.

words.ex: The savage wolf howled under the moon.
words.ex_cn: 那头野性的狼在月光下嚎叫。
words.en: A savage person or animal is very fierce and violent.

words.ex: The child looked sleepy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后看起来想睡觉。
words.en: If you are sleepy, you are tired and ready to go to sleep.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The drummer changed the tempo of the song.
words.ex_cn: 鼓手改变了这首歌的拍子。
words.en: The speed at which a piece of music is played or the rate or speed of motion or activity.

words.tr: adj. 被忽视的；未被注意的
words.ex: Her warnings went unheeded.
words.ex_cn: 她的警告被忽视了。
words.en: If something is unheeded, it is ignored or not taken notice of.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The phone shows a small vibration when it rings.
words.ex_cn: 手机响时会轻微震动。
words.en: A vibration is a continuous slight shaking movement.

chapters.name: Unit 9 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语. 在驾驶；掌舵；控制（机器或系统）
words.ex: He is at the wheel of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他正在开车。
words.en: In control of a vehicle or situation.

words.tr: 短语. 在驾驶车辆；掌管方向盘
words.ex: She feels most confident when she's behind the wheel.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 当她驾驶时，她感到最自信。
words.en: In control of a vehicle, driving.

words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr:
n. 亲笔签名；亲笔稿
v. 亲笔签名于；亲笔书写
words.ex: He asked the singer for an autograph.
words.ex_cn: 他向歌手要了一张签名。
words.en: An autograph is a person's own signature, especially that of a famous person, or a manuscript in the author's own handwriting.

words.ex: The rifle has a 5.56 mm caliber.
words.ex_cn: 这把步枪的口径是5.56毫米。
words.en: The caliber of something or someone is their quality, especially when this is high.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.ex: He covets his neighbor's car.
words.ex_cn: 他垂涎邻居的车。
words.en: If you covet something, you have a very strong desire to possess it, especially something that belongs to someone else.

words.ex: He felt disenchantment after learning the truth about his idol.
words.ex_cn: 当他了解到自己偶像的真相后，感到幻想破灭。
words.en: Disenchantment is a feeling of disappointment about someone or something you previously respected or admired, because you have discovered that they are not as good as you believed.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.tr: n. 非正义；不公平；不公正
words.ex: He cried out against the injustice.
words.ex_cn: 他抗议这种不公。
words.en: Injustice refers to the lack of fairness or justice in a situation or action.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.ex: He became a millionaire after selling his app.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉自己的应用后成了百万富翁。
words.en: A millionaire is a person whose wealth amounts to a million or more in currency units such as dollars, pounds, or euros.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: The village has a quaint old church.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一座古色古香的古老教堂。
words.en: Something that is quaint is attractive because it is unusual and old-fashioned.

words.ex: They have good rapport with their students.
words.ex_cn: 他们与学生关系友好。
words.en: A friendly relationship in which people understand each other very well.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: n. 装订工；粘合剂；活页夹
words.ex: The binder stitched the pages together neatly.
words.ex_cn: 装订工把页面整齐地装订在一起。
words.en: A binder is a cover for holding loose sheets of paper, magazines, etc., together.

words.ex: He read a biographical book about Einstein.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于爱因斯坦的传记书籍。
words.en: Relating to the events of a person's life as written by someone else.

words.tr: adj. 仁慈的；慈善事业的；
words.ex: She gave charitable donations to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 她向穷人捐赠了仁慈的善款。
words.en: A charitable organization or activity helps and supports people who are ill, very poor, or who have disabilities.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.tr: adv. 严重地；批评地；危急地；
words.ex: The patient is critically ill.
words.ex_cn: 病人病情严重。
words.en: In a way that involves the objective analysis and judgment of the merits and faults of a work of literature, music, or art.

words.ex: He needs dialysis twice a week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周需要透析两次。
words.en: Dialysis is a medical process of removing wastes and excess water from the blood by diffusion and ultrafiltration.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.ex: Please ensure the door is locked.
words.ex_cn: 请确保门锁好了。
words.en: To make certain that something will occur or be the case.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.ex: The non-profit helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个非营利组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A non-profit organization is one that is not run with the aim of making a profit.

words.ex: The performer danced on stage with great energy.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者在舞台上充满活力地跳舞。
words.en: A performer is a person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The store gave out promotional flyers to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店分发了促销传单来吸引顾客。
words.en: Relating to or involved in the publicizing of a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

words.tr:
n. 说唱乐
v. 说唱；敲击
words.ex: He loves to rap about his life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢说唱自己在城市里的生活。
words.en: A type of music characterized by rhythmic and/or rhyming speech that is chanted or rapped.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: He is a songwriter who writes happy songs.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创作快乐歌曲的作曲家。
words.en: A songwriter is a person who writes the words or the music, or both, for songs.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: He is a superstar in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球界的超级巨星。
words.en: A superstar is a person who is extremely famous and successful, especially in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.tr: adj. 令人振奋的； v. “uplift”的现在分词；
words.ex: The music was uplifting and made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 这首音乐令人振奋，让每个人都露出了笑容。
words.en: Something that is uplifting makes you feel very cheerful and happy.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: The vocalist sang a beautiful song.
words.ex_cn: 主唱唱了一首美妙的歌。
words.en: A vocalist is a singer, especially one who sings popular music.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is in need of help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If someone or something is in need of something, they need it.

words.tr: phrase. 反复地；一遍又一遍地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: If you say that something happens over and over or over and over again, you are emphasizing that it happens many times.

words.ex: He gave an absolute yes to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了完全肯定的回答。
words.en: Absolute means complete and total, or not limited in any way.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: He is a diarist who writes every night.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位每天晚上都写日记的日记作者。
words.en: A diarist is a person who writes a diary, especially one that is published.

words.tr: adj. 自我本位的；任性的；自负的
words.ex: He is egotistical and always talks about himself.
words.ex_cn: 他很自我中心，总是谈论自己。
words.en: If you describe someone as egotistical, you disapprove of them because they behave as if they are more important or better than other people.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: The doctor explained the disease in layman terms.
words.ex_cn: 医生用通俗易懂的语言解释了这种疾病。
words.en: A layman is a person who does not have specialized or professional knowledge of a subject.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: He visits a therapist for psychoanalysis every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都去看心理医生做精神分析。
words.en: A method of treating mental disorders by investigating the interaction of conscious and unconscious elements in the mind and bringing repressed fears and conflicts into the conscious mind.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.tr: phrase. 减震器; 缓冲器; 防震器; 阻尼器
words.ex: The car has a broken shock absorber.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个坏掉的减震器。
words.en: A device for reducing the effect of a sudden blow or impact, especially on a vehicle.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

chapters.name: Unit 10 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语动词。与…和平相处；接受并内心平静地面对（某人或某事）
words.ex: He is at peace with his choices.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己所做的选择感到平静。
words.en: to be in a state of mutual harmony or contentment with someone or something, often after a period of conflict or dissatisfaction.

words.ex: He was born with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他生来就有音乐天赋。
words.en: To have a particular quality or ability from birth.

words.ex: He is confronted with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be faced with or opposed by something or someone, typically in a challenging or hostile manner.

words.ex: He started to learn English early on.
words.ex_cn: 他很早就开始学英语了。
words.en: At an early stage of a period of time or process.

words.tr: 短语动词，具有……的能力；能够胜任……
words.ex: He has a capacity for learning new things quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有快速学习新事物的能力。
words.en: To possess the ability or potential to do something.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: phrase. 从……来判断；根据……来看
words.ex: Judging from his expression, he is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 从他的表情来看，他并不开心。
words.en: If you say that something is the case judging from a particular thing, you mean that it is the case based on that thing.

words.ex: He lost touch with his old friends after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到一个新城市后，和老朋友失去了联系。
words.en: To no longer communicate with someone or be informed about something.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He stared in amazement at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.

words.ex: The priest gave a benediction at the end of the service.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在仪式结束时给予了祝福。
words.en: A benediction is a prayer asking for God's blessing, especially one at the end of a religious service.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.ex: Dew forms on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露水出现在草地上。
words.en: Dew is small drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.tr: adj. 赞成的；有利的；嘉许的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a favorable comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师对我的作文给予了赞成的评价。
words.en: If something makes a favorable impression on you or is favorable to you, you like it or approve of it.

words.tr: n. 赋格曲；朦胧状态；神游症
words.ex: He composed a fugue for the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他为钢琴创作了一首赋格曲。
words.en: A fugue is a piece of music that begins with a theme that is then repeated and developed by different voices or instruments in a structured manner.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.ex: The grower sells fresh vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位种植者在市场出售新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A grower is someone who grows plants or crops as a business or for personal use.

words.ex: He is an honourable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位正直可敬的人，总是说真话。
words.en: If you describe people or actions as honourable, you mean that they are good and deserve to be respected and admired.

words.ex: His humor makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: It is inconceivable that he forgot his own birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了自己生日，这简直难以想象。
words.en: If something is inconceivable, it is impossible to imagine or believe because it is so unlikely.

words.tr: adv. 无限地；无穷地；极大地；
words.ex: The stars are infinitely far away.
words.ex_cn: 星星离得无限远。
