words.en: In a way that is without limits or bounds; extremely or immeasurably.

words.ex: He worked intensely to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他强烈地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If something is intense, it is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.tr: n. 艺术大师（尤值作曲家；指挥家等）；
words.ex: The maestro conducted the orchestra with great passion.
words.ex_cn: 这位大师充满激情地指挥了管弦乐队。
words.en: A maestro is a distinguished musician, especially a conductor of classical music.

words.ex: The village is built on the mountainside.
words.ex_cn: 村庄建在山腰上。
words.en: The side or slope of a mountain.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: The moon has a periodic cycle of phases.
words.ex_cn: 月亮的相位变化是周期性的。
words.en: Happening or appearing at regular intervals.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: Plants grow better with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光下生长得更好。
words.en: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: n. 兴致；热情；趣味；（用于调味的）柠檬皮；橙皮
words.ex: He cooks with zest and loves spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他做菜很有激情，喜欢辣的食物。
words.en: Great enthusiasm and energy.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He stayed home in view of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雨，他待在家里。
words.en: You use 'in view of' when you are taking into consideration a particular fact or situation that is important in relation to what you are saying or doing.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: v. 唤醒；唤起；使意识到
words.ex: The loud noise awakened him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他吵醒了。
words.en: If you awaken a feeling or emotion, or if it awakens, it starts to be felt or experienced.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: The continual rain made the road very muddy.
words.ex_cn: 不停的雨让道路变得非常泥泞。
words.en: Something that is continual happens repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The cornstalk is tall and green.
words.ex_cn: 玉米秆又高又绿。
words.en: A cornstalk is the stem of a corn plant, which remains after the corn has been harvested.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.tr:
v. 嘎吱嘎吱地动；发嘎吱嘎吱声
n. 嘎吱声；艰难局面；危急情况
words.ex: The dog crunches the bone loudly.
words.ex_cn: 狗嘎吱嘎吱地咬着骨头。
words.en: To crunch means to chew noisily with your mouth open, or to make a loud noise like the sound of something being crushed. It can also refer to a critical point or situation, especially in financial contexts.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的； v. “fleet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smile was fleeting.
words.ex_cn: 那个微笑是短暂的。
words.en: If you describe something as fleeting, you mean that it lasts only for a very short time.

words.tr: n. 脆弱性；脆性；易碎性
words.ex: The fragility of the glass made it easy to break.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃的易碎性让它很容易破碎。
words.en: The quality of being easily broken or damaged.

words.tr: adj. 受霜害的，生冻疮的 v. 冻伤( frostbite的过去分词 )
words.ex: His fingers are frostbitten from the cold snow.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指因寒冷的雪而冻伤了。
words.en: Affected by frostbite; injured or damaged by frost.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: He felt nothingness after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 失去后，他感到一片虚无。
words.en: The state of being nothing; nonexistence.

words.tr: adj. 执拗的；固执的；顽固的；
words.ex: He is obstinate and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很执拗，不肯改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as obstinate, you are being critical of them because they are very determined to do what they want, and refuse to change their mind or be persuaded to do something else.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.tr: adv. 永恒地；持久地；无休止地
words.ex: He is perpetually late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是上课迟到。
words.en: If something happens perpetually, it happens all the time or very often.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.tr: adj. 紧迫的； v. 按；“press”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pressing issue is finding clean water.
words.ex_cn: 紧迫的问题是找到干净的水。
words.en: If something is pressing, it needs to be dealt with immediately because it is important or urgent.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: A shudder ran through her when she saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到蛇时，全身战栗了一下。
words.en: If you shudder, you shake with fear, horror, or disgust, or because you are cold.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.tr: n. 谢意; 感谢，感激; 谢忱
words.ex: He showed thankfulness for the help he received.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对所收到帮助的感激。
words.en: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation for and to return kindness.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: The windowpane is cracked from the storm.
words.ex_cn: 窗户玻璃因风暴而裂了。
words.en: A windowpane is a piece of glass in a window.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 不知不觉地来临；悄悄靠近
words.ex: Time can creep up on you if you're not careful.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不小心，时间会悄悄溜走。
words.en: To approach someone or something stealthily or gradually, often without being noticed.

words.ex: In any case, we should proceed with the plan.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，我们应该继续执行这个计划。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; whatever the situation is or will be.

words.tr: phrase. 使…无法近身；遏制；阻止…发展
words.ex: They kept the cold at bay with warm clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们用暖和的衣服把寒冷挡在外面。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from approaching or having an effect.

words.tr: phrase. 把……挡开；使……无法接近；暂时控制住（危险、困难等）
words.ex: They held the enemy at bay with strong defense.
words.ex_cn: 他们用强有力的防守将敌人击退。
words.en: To keep someone or something at a distance or prevent them from causing harm or trouble.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使……处于控制之下；暂时阻止……靠近或发生
words.ex: They have the fire at bay with water hoses.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水管把火势控制住了。
words.en: To keep someone or something at a distance or prevent them from causing harm or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 不许入内； 挡在外面
words.ex: The fence is to keep out animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆是用来挡动物的。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility for something.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.
